title: Electric Shock
description: Learn how EVs are changing the automotive landscape, based on data from EV Kranti. Watch to discover the impact of electric vehicles on the car market and how AI-generated visuals enhance our explanation.

scenes.narration: Electric vehicles are revolutionizing the car industry
With many new models launching every year
They offer a cleaner alternative to traditional gas-powered cars
And some countries are even offering incentives to buy electric
As a result, EV sales are skyrocketing globally
The electric revolution is here, and it's changing the road ahead
